<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target molecule (the product of the Doebner modification), reproduces the forward reaction. The product is trans‑cinnamic acid, SMILES “O=C(O)/C=C/c1ccccc1”. By searching the template catalog for a template that breaks a C–O bond (aldehyde) and forms a C=C bond, we can obtain the template ID and its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)/C=C/c1ccccc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehyde"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C-C (1.0->2.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
